verses.1: But the souls of the just are in the hand of God and no torment of death will touch them.
verses.2: In the eyes of the foolish, they seemed to die, and their departure was considered an affliction,
verses.3: and their going away from us, a banishment. Yet they are in peace.
verses.4: And though, in the sight of men, they suffered torments, their hope is full of immortality.
verses.5: Troubled in few things, in many things they will be well compensated, because God has tested them and found them worthy of himself.
verses.6: Like gold in the furnace, he has proved them, and as a holocaust victim, he has received them, and in the time of their visitation
verses.7: they will shine, and they will dash about like sparks among stubble.
verses.8: They will judge the nations and they will rule over the people, and their Lord will reign forever.
verses.9: Those who trust in him, will understand the truth, and those who are faithful in love will rest in him, because grace and peace is for his elect.
verses.10: But the impious will be chastised according to their thoughts, for they have neglected the just and have retreated from the Lord.
verses.11: For whoever abandons wisdom and instruction is unhappy, and their hope is empty, and their labors without fruit, and their works useless.
verses.12: Their wives are foolish and their sons are wicked; the things that serve them are accursed.
verses.13: Therefore, fertile is the barren and undefiled, who has not known transgressions in bed; she will bear fruit by caring for holy souls.
verses.14: And fertile is the celibate, who has not wrought iniquity with his hands, nor thought wickedness against God; for to him will be given a special gift of faith and a very welcome place in the temple of the Lord.
verses.15: For the fruit of good labors is glorious and the root of wisdom shall never perish.
verses.16: But the sons of adulterers will not reach completion, and the offspring of a sinful bed will be banished.
verses.17: And if they live long, they will be counted as nothing, and their last years of old-age will be without honor.
verses.18: And if they die quickly, they will have no hope, nor words of comfort on the day of reckoning.
verses.19: For the iniquities of the people have a dreadful result. [ Wisdom 4 ]
